input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including offer data. The platform provides capabilities for application exception handler. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to create and manage offer data records, so that I can track and organize offer data data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to interact with get offer by id endpoint functionality, so that I can accomplish my get offer by id endpoint-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with get offers endpoint functionality, so that I can accomplish my get offers endpoint-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to use application exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
